provider: AlgoArena hosted / open-source Alpaca SIP proxy
findings: Official/open-source AlgoArena README states its market data comes from Alpaca's SIP feed (NBBO), exposes a REST paper-trading API, and names hosted base URL https://algoarena.markets/api/v1.
The actual AlpacaClientService hard-codes `feed: 'sip'` on U.S.-equity data requests, so the SIP claim is present in production source code rather than only marketing text.
The source maps Alpaca quote timestamps and snapshots containing latestTrade.timestamp plus latestQuote.timestamp, so B has a technically plausible independent quote/trade event-time route.
Hosted market-data endpoints are scheduler-friendly and rate-limited at 120 requests/minute per CUID; quote/snapshot cache TTL is 5 seconds.

The README simultaneously says self-hosting works with Alpaca free-tier credentials. That statement conflicts with current Alpaca entitlement behavior: the working free route is IEX-only and SIP is not a permanent-$0 Basic entitlement. A self-hosted free credential therefore cannot be assumed to satisfy G9.

For the hosted algoarena.markets service, no primary-source market-data terms or Alpaca redistribution/non-display licensing statement was found proving that the operator may redistribute SIP/NBBO data to downstream automated users permanently at $0.
The repository MIT license grants rights to the software, not to upstream exchange/SIP market data. It cannot satisfy strict G9-C.
Therefore AlgoArena is a genuinely distinct technical route but cannot authorize strict G9 without explicit upstream redistribution/non-display entitlement and permanent-$0 user terms.

source_code_evidence.critical_code_behavior: dataRequest(...) always merges {feed:'sip'} for U.S. equities

reopen_condition: Only reopen if AlgoArena or Alpaca publishes primary-source proof of a valid SIP/NBBO redistribution arrangement for the hosted service and explicit permanent-$0 end-user automated/non-display entitlement with no fee, funding, balance, activity, or subscription condition.
evidence: AlgoArena's official repository states that equity market data comes from Alpaca's SIP feed (NBBO), and its Alpaca adapter hard-codes feed=sip on equity market-data requests.

The hosted agent guide publishes https://algoarena.markets/api/v1 and documents read-only market-data access using only an AlgoArena CUID, with a self-service API-key request workflow for user provisioning.

The canonical snapshot shape exposes latestQuote.timestamp and latestTrade.timestamp independently; quotes and snapshots are cached for 5 seconds, so the technical B/D surface is strong pending live RTH validation.

AlgoArena self-host configuration requires Alpaca credentials. Alpaca's official current support states Free market-data accounts receive realtime IEX only; current full-market SIP realtime requires the paid/full-market entitlement.
Alpaca's current customer agreement states users may not reproduce, distribute, sell, or commercially exploit Alpaca market data without written consent from Alpaca.

No primary-source AlgoArena document found proves that the hosted service possesses Alpaca/CTA/UTP written redistribution authorization covering end-user automated/non-display access, or that such access is permanently $0 with no separate upstream market-data fee/condition.
Therefore technical use of Alpaca SIP by the hosted backend is not sufficient to prove strict gate C; authority remains fail-closed.
AlgoArena source code forces feed=sip on equity market-data requests and its hosted agent guide exposes read-only quote/snapshot endpoints from algoarena.markets.
AlgoArena self-hosted configuration requires Alpaca API credentials; hosted production therefore relies on server-side Alpaca credentials rather than end-user Alpaca credentials.
Alpaca's official support states Alpaca API market data cannot be redistributed via another platform without the relevant arrangement/consent.
Alpaca's Broker API guidance states premium SIP redistribution carries a cost that may be subsidized across partners but is not zero.
No primary-source evidence was found that AlgoArena holds a special redistribution agreement granting permanent-$0 SIP/NBBO API access to its end users.
